name: EIA-923 May 2026 Energy Storage Rows — Plant 60014
known_limitations: The EIA survey row is monthly, subject to revision, and does not expose interval dispatch or availability. Its quantity-consumed, gross-generation, and net-generation fields must not be converted into an efficiency claim without reconciling the survey definitions and reported totals. Phase 56J keeps the coverage ID, entity identity, attribution, period, evidence state, and continuation rule attached.
